images.author: Mauricio Manzato
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Everest at sunset from Tibet base camp. Clear blue sky and isolated summit make this a strong poster candidate. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Ben Gao
images.why: Photographer identifies Mount Everest in Tibet, China; snowy mountain against blue sky offers a daylight alternative. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Success Dhamala
images.why: Photographer confirms sunrise behind Everest from Kala Patthar, Nepal—the classic Nepal-side viewpoint. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Slava Auchynnikau
images.why: Source identifies Everest illuminated by golden sunrise light and locates the photograph in Nepal. Strong warm-colour option; exact viewpoint and native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Dylan Shaw
images.why: Photographer confirms a predawn view overlooking Everest and its Nepal base camp, with stars and a small human figure. Atmospheric alternative; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Blake Randall
images.why: Dramatic portrait composition of K2 from Concordia, with storm light and a dominant summit; well suited to a 9:10 crop. Filename indicates a 1920px version, below the preferred resolution.

images.author: Stuart Orford
images.why: Classic Concordia view with K2's summit above drifting clouds, blue sky and dark glacier foreground. Freely licensed fallback; this linked Flickr version is limited to 1024px.

images.author: Labun Hang Limboo
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Kangchenjunga from Pelling, West Sikkim, India. Classic Indian-side view with blue sky; crop around the main summit. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: NSG
images.why: Source identifies Kangchenjunga and tags sunrise and Tiger Hill. Promising dawn alternative for the familiar Indian-side massif view; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Dan Thompson
images.why: Original photographer's upload explicitly identifies Gangkhar Puensum, photographed in November 2016. Lower-resolution fallback: linked version is 1024px; a larger licensed file would be preferable.
